falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at ~4,800; this would signal the current structure is weaker than the reference pattern and not a valid bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak near 28; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling beyond the reference pattern's stress levels, proving this is not a comparable bottom but rather a breakdown into deeper correction

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% and stays there for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid this extreme would signal recession/deleveraging panic rather than the soft-landing bottom pattern of August 2024, when yields stabilized in the 3.8-4.0% range; this invalidates the macro regime similarity
